offerings.name: Web Search API
offerings.pricing: Search costs 2 credits per 10 results. Hobby: $16/month billed yearly, including 2,500 searches or 5,000 pages scraped.
offerings.price_basis: Hobby annual plan；search按每10个结果计费并向上取整
offerings.free_quota: 1,000 credits / month；500 searches or 1,000 pages scraped
offerings.output_type: 结构化网页、新闻和图片搜索结果，含URL、标题与描述；可选返回Markdown、HTML、链接或截图
offerings.note: 1–10个结果2 credits，11–20个4 credits；抓取结果时另收每页抓取费用。

offerings.name: End-to-End ZDR
offerings.price_basis: Enterprise ZDR search；10 credits per 10 results
offerings.output_type: 零数据保留的结构化搜索结果
offerings.note: 仅Enterprise可用；Firecrawl及上游搜索提供商均不存储查询或结果数据。
